Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso Duetto Diamonds, reference 266.1.44, from 2010–2020, with manual-winding movement, a yellow-gold reversible case set with 32 diamonds (~0.32 ct), silver guilloché dial on the front and a second silver guilloché dial with a nacre centre, a new leather strap with a yellow-gold deployant buckle, and in unused condition.
AI-assisted summary

Description from the seller

Jaeger-LeCoultre Reverso Duetto

Reference: 266.1.44

18k white gold reversible case polished and brushed
Sapphire crystals (no scratches)
Front dial: silver guilloché analog-type with Arabic numerals, railway minute track and blued hands
Case back set with 32 brilliant-cut diamonds (total approx. 0.32 carats)
Second dial: silver guilloché analog-type with nacre center, no indices, and gold hands
Manual-winding mechanical movement
Leather strap new with yellow gold deployant buckle signed

Measurements:
Case diameter (crown excluded): 20.7 mm
Interhorn width: 14 mm
Lug-to-lug length: 33 mm
Total bracelet length: 180 mm
Gross weight: 50.04 g

The watch is accompanied by its service pouch

For a better idea of the condition and dimensions, please refer to the photos. This watch has benefited from an overhaul by our Jaeger-LeCoultre‑authorized watchmaker, including a full movement revision, crown and all seals replacement, renewal of water resistance, and complete polishing for a total of €1129.20. The watch comes with a 12‑month warranty. A copy of the invoice will be given to the buyer

The photographed item is the one you are purchasing

Insured shipping to the value. Satisfied or refunded

Delivery France & international: DHL Express 48h insured to the value of the sale
